projectDescription: Alowish is an AI-powered health risk intelligence platform that assesses personalized travel health risks in real time — pairing each user's health profile with destination environmental data to deliver safe-route guidance, clinical recommendations, and access to healthcare services worldwide.
keyFeatures: Personalized travel health risk scoring using a Bayesian-Fuzzy neural engine (EBF-NN v3, SN1–SN11 subnetworks)
Real-time RADAR: live weather, air quality (AQI), altitude, and seasonal data fused into the risk score
Life Map (GIS + AI): interactive smart map showing color-coded route risk, hospitals, pharmacies, healthy restaurants, and safe alternatives
12 health verticals: Cardiac, Respiratory, Diabetes, Oncology, Neuro, Renal, Mental, Allergy, Pregnancy, Autoimmune, Elderly, Disability
Route comparison: Train, Motorway, Scenic — each scored and ranked by health risk with waypoint-level breakdowns
Dr. Alowish AI Chat: conversational AI family doctor that answers travel health questions and shows personalized recommendations on the map
Telemedicine integration: connect to travel medicine specialists, cardiologists, and other doctors before or during a journey
Medication and drug-environment interaction alerts (e.g., Warfarin + heat, Beta-blocker + altitude)
LGE-based cardiac risk model aligned with JAMA 2024 findings (HR=2.69, n=29,687)
Swiss sovereign data infrastructure powered by QLever knowledge graph (SPARQL, RDF, <80ms queries)
Partner API for embedding health risk intelligence into travel apps, insurance platforms, and corporate travel systems
publicApiSurface: POST /v1/risk/assess — calculate personalized health risk score for a destination
GET /v1/destinations/{id}/conditions — retrieve environmental health conditions for a location
GET /v1/routes — compare health risk across travel routes between two points
GET /v1/services/nearby — find hospitals, pharmacies, and health services near a coordinate
POST /v1/profile — create or update a user health profile
POST /v1/telemedicine/consult — initiate a telemedicine consultation request
POST /v1/webhooks — register a webhook endpoint for real-time risk alerts
